upstream.description: The main repository for all the Code Maze guides

classification.analysis: CodeMazeGuides is the code-sample repository backing the Code Maze .NET blog, containing hundreds of small, self-contained ASP.NET Core / .NET solutions (one folder per article) covering topics like background services, MVC controllers, EF Core, and web API patterns. It is primarily a reference collection for C#/.NET developers to browse working examples tied to specific blog posts and tutorials rather than a single cohesive application. It is very actively maintained, with new example projects added continuously and CI validating each solution builds.

use_cases.title: Find a working ASP.NET Core example for a specific pattern like background services or MVC
Follow along with a Code Maze blog tutorial using the matching solution folder
Copy a minimal reproducible .NET project as a starting point for a new feature
